title: Verification quorum can still pass with one reviewer after provider failures

finding.claim: Verification quorum can still pass with one reviewer after provider failures
finding.evidence: The new quorum check is based on the configured provider count via 'quorum_ok = len(ok_recs) >= 2 or len(providers) <= 1'. If multiple providers are configured but only one succeeds and the others fail, later logic can still return pass when there are no open findings and degraded is false in non-strict mode.
finding.recommendation: Base pass eligibility on successful reviewer count whenever more than one provider was intended for the run, and make degraded verification inconclusive regardless of strict mode if quorum is not met.
